description: Defines the GroupRole entity class for the Fineract project, representing roles assigned to clients within groups, including methods for creation, updating, and change detection.

classes.name: GroupRole
classes.description: Entity class representing a role assigned to a client within a group, with methods for creation, updating, and change detection.

methods.name: createGroupRole
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new GroupRole instance with specified group, client, and role.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Detects changes in client ID and role ID based on a JsonCommand and returns a map of actual changes.

methods.name: updateRole
methods.description: Updates the role associated with this GroupRole.

methods.name: updateClient
methods.description: Updates the client associated with this GroupRole.
